connection.live.label.description: Small badge at the top right: the console receives updates the moment they happen. One word.

connection.live.title.message: New tabs show up the moment they are sent.

connection.polling.label.description: Small badge at the top right: the console asks the relay for news every 20 seconds instead of receiving it at once. One word.

connection.polling.title.message: Live updates are off. Checking for new tabs every 20 seconds, so nothing is lost.
connection.polling.title.description: Tooltip on the “Checking” badge. A “relay” is the server that passes tabs between devices.

connection.offline.label.description: Small badge at the top right: the relay does not answer. One word.

connection.offline.title.message: Not connected to the relay at {relayUrl}.
connection.offline.title.description: Tooltip on the “Offline” badge. {relayUrl} is the address of the relay (a web address). A “relay” is the server that passes tabs between devices.

connection.offline.titleHomeNetwork.message: Not connected to the relay at {relayUrl}. This address only works on your home network. Away from home or on mobile data? Connect to your home Wi-Fi or turn on your VPN.
connection.offline.titleHomeNetwork.description: Same as the “Offline” tooltip, for a relay at a home-network address, with the extra advice. {relayUrl} is the relay's address. The last three sentences are the same words as in the browser extension and the phone apps.
